findings.opportunity: One snapshot build parses the formal Semantic Model (all four partitions) 2 + N times: buildSemanticModelSource reads it once (view.ts:216), the new Candidate-Diff union path added by this change reads it again (view.ts:324), compileChangeDelta without options.base re-reads it once per active Change (view.ts:252 -> change-compiler.ts:138), and the authoredViews section reads it a fourth time (view.ts:418). The candidate validator adds yet another formal parse (src/core/candidate/validator.ts:343, outside base scope). compileChangeDelta already supports a pre-parsed base (change-compiler.ts:25-29: 'Pre-parsed Semantic Model; avoids re-reading the four partitions'), but buildChangeDerivedView never passes it.
findings.impact: Collapses 2 + N whole-model four-partition parses per snapshot build into one, on every `xirang view` launch and every 75ms-debounced watcher refresh after any model/candidate/change edit. Also removes the current race where concurrent consumers (buildSemanticModelSource vs buildCandidateSources) can observe different formal file states mid-edit and produce a mixed snapshot.
evidence: src/core/view.ts:216 `const { model } = await readFormalSemanticModel(projectRoot)` inside buildSemanticModelSource
src/core/view.ts:324 `unionSemanticModels((await readFormalSemanticModel(projectRoot)).model, candidateModel.model)` added by this change inside buildCandidateSources
src/core/view.ts:252 `const compiledDelta = await compileChangeDelta(projectRoot, change)` with no base option, once per active change
src/core/view.ts:418 `const { model } = await readFormalSemanticModel(projectRoot)` for authoredViews
src/core/change-compiler.ts:50-52 readFormalSemanticModel = parseSemanticModel(modelRoot(projectRoot)) with no caching layer (src/core/model/parser.ts has no memoization)
src/core/change-compiler.ts:133-139 compileChangeDelta accepts options.base and only re-reads when it is absent
buildCandidateSources / buildSemanticModelSource / buildChangeDerivedView / unionSemanticModels have no callers outside src/core/view.ts (grep confirms), so the refactor is fully internal
findings.recommendation: Hoist a single `const formal = await readFormalSemanticModel(projectRoot)` to the top of buildViewRuntimeSnapshot, pass it into buildSemanticModelSource(formal), buildCandidateSources(projectRoot, formal) (use formal.model for the union when result.comparison.baseline === 'formal'), and buildChangeDerivedView(projectRoot, change, formal) which calls compileChangeDelta(projectRoot, change, { base: formal }). Reuse formal.model for authoredViews resolution.
findings.keyDesign: One immutable ParsedModel per snapshot build. Consumers keep their exact current semantics: buildCandidateSources uses it only when comparison.baseline === 'formal'; buildChangeDerivedView passes it as CompileChangeOptions.base so compiledDelta.base.model, formalFingerprint, and diagnostic index content are identical to a fresh read.
preservationConstraints: Parsed model content is byte-identical to what each current read returns (same parser, same files); no consumer mutates ParsedModel (unionSemanticModels copies into new Maps, projectBrowserArchitecture maps to new structures)

A formal read failure still rejects buildViewRuntimeSnapshot with the same exception (today buildSemanticModelSource:216 rejects the Promise.all; hoisting rejects earlier at the same call site with the same error; per-change catch diagnostics were never delivered in that scenario either)

findings.opportunity: buildCandidateSources unconditionally materializes the Candidate Diff union on every snapshot build: unionSemanticModels + projectBrowserArchitecture(unionModel) + partitionFingerprints(unionModel) (a JSON.stringify of the whole union model) + runtimeLikeC4(unionModel) (full LikeC4 source text generation), even when the user never opens Candidate Diff. The manifest JSON written on every refresh then carries the union LikeC4 text alongside the candidate text.
findings.impact: Skipping or lazily generating the union would cut per-refresh CPU and manifest size for large models; the benefit scales with model size and candidate-edit frequency and depends on whether Candidate Diff is opened, so it is workload-dependent.
evidence: src/core/view.ts:323-338 union computation plus runtimeLikeC4(unionModel, 'diffLikec4Sources', 'diffLikec4ElementPaths') runs whenever result.valid && unionModel, before any projection request
src/core/view.ts:512 writeViewRuntimeSnapshot JSON-serializes the whole snapshot including the union LikeC4 text on every refresh
Lazy delivery would require the projection handler or manifest protocol to request union sources on demand, crossing the core/vite-plugin package boundary
findings.recommendation: Do not change now. A follow-up change could generate diffLikec4Sources lazily (e.g., a manifest-driven on-demand endpoint or separate snapshot section built only when candidate-diff is first requested), after profiling real model sizes and refresh rates.
findings.keyDesign: On-demand union materialization scoped to candidate-diff projection requests, with the current eager output kept as the correctness fallback.
preservationConstraints: diffSourceFingerprint, diffArchitecture, diffLikec4Sources, and diffLikec4ElementPaths must remain present and identical whenever Candidate Diff is requested
The removed-ghost fallback to candidate-only target sources must keep working
